Ban.dc.html.title: 4 · I7 Before and after the ban

t1.text: Edo and the floating world · the learner's journey, as screens

n1.text: 1 · The case page is the hub. The system diagram is the index: tap a box and the lectures and interactives that operate it light up. Everything a learner meets is reachable from here.

n2.text: 2–4 · One lecture and three interactives, working. The lecture is a station tour with one-tap predictions and an argued station; the interactives are joints of the system: read the margin, drag across 1842, price a sheet.

n3.text: 5–6 · The Atlas holds the case as nodes under four lenses; a node card opens from any lens. Images: 17 open objects (Met CC0, Cleveland CC0) fetched from the holders' records; AIC's three returned 403 and are placeholders.
